settlementMerit.rationale: Pittenweem remains a strong working-harbour and arts destination with historic fabric, tidal pool, coastal walking and a live treasure trail. Its Eat list is now restricted to true café, sweet-treat and refreshment stops.

eat.focus: Cafés, coffee and cake, tearooms, farm cafés, bakeries, sweet treats and light lunches; meal-led restaurants, pubs and takeaways excluded.
eat.note: Cocoa Tree, Clock Tower Café, Nicholson’s and West Braes Hut retained.
